set.body: Owner: ScalaFIM scientific adapters; generic NIfTI codec and incremental source/sink capabilities belong in image4s-nifti. Current image4s already encodes through bounded writeChunks on JVM and Node, while its public writeScalar consumes an image. Determine and reproduce any missing block-produced output API in image4s, implement/test in that native store, then adopt exact dependency and reuse it for ScalaFIM selected-result staging. Keep fit identities, map names/units, geometry, scientific completeness and catalog binding here; do not grow a second generic NIfTI codec. Acceptance includes no whole-map materialization, no existing-target clobber, scalar/affine/units parity, sparse block ordering and bounded heap, provider JVM/JS/Node plus direct consumer evidence. This replaces the prematurely placed unqualified ScalaFIM block writer; that draft was restored/removed exactly, with preservation receipt /private/tmp/scalafim-selected-output-withdrawal.json. Parent transactional sink/catalog remains open.
set.title: Adopt image4s incremental NIfTI output for selected result maps
